Աշխատում եմ film-crew → seedance-25-director-ով.

**Session note:** This folder isn't a git repo and has no NOTES.md, so I couldn't pull or check what's open. I didn't change any files, so there's no NOTES entry or push.

**Assumptions**
- No reference images. Identity is held by text, and all three shots are made in one Seedance call so they stay consistent.
- Seedance makes **picture and room sound only**. Your Armenian VO, any music and the logo go on in the edit. If you upload the VO as @Audio, Seedance may re-voice or garble the Armenian, and it can't render the logo correctly.
- Nobody on screen speaks, so there's no Armenian lip-sync to fail.
- Pages show no readable letters, because generated Armenian script comes out garbled. "In Armenian" is carried by the VO and the end card.
- I ran film-crew as a short pass for 3 shots and didn't write the full 00–10 file package. The plan is below.

## Crew plan (cut to the VO)

| VO | Shot | Beat | Camera / light | Cut |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0–4.0 "Every child has a question…" | 1 · 0–4.5 s · CU | A 7-year-old girl draws a question mark on a fogged night window. No answer comes. | Slow push-in, cool moonlight from frame-left, graphite dark | Hard cut at 4.5 s in the VO gap: a lamp click switches cold light to warm |
| 4.5–9.0 "We write the books that answer it…" | 2 · 4.5–9.5 s · MS→CU | The same girl opens a black book with a red ribbon. The page light hits her face, her eyes widen and a small smile starts. | Push-in, warm amber lamp from frame-right, page glow from below | Hard cut at 9.5 s in the VO gap. The right-to-left page turn carries into a right-to-left dolly |
| 9.5–14.0 "Maghakian Scripts. Books for ages 0–16." | 3 · 9.5–15 s · WS | A toddler, the girl and a teenager read side by side (ages 0–16). The camera then tilts up to an empty wall. | Lateral dolly right-to-left, then tilt up. The top two-thirds of the last frame is clean wall for the logo | End card in the edit |

- **Look:** quiet storybook realism, 35mm-lens look, shallow focus, black/graphite/white with warm lamplight. The red ribbon is the only red, matching the brand's single red accent.
- **Edit tasks (not generation):**
  - Lay the VO from 0.0 s.
  - Add soft music under it.
  - From about 12.8 s, fade in the white-ink logo (`maghakian_logo_light.png`) on the empty wall, with a line under it. Suggested line: «Գրքեր 0-ից 16 տարեկանների համար».

**Risks**
- The girl's face may drift between shots. If it does, make one still of her first with banana-pro-director-2.0, upload it as @Image 1 and add "use @Image 1 as strict identity reference for the girl".
- The fog question mark may come out mirrored or messy. You may need 2–3 tries.

## FINAL

**Settings (Dreamina):**
- Seedance 2.5, **Omni Reference** mode
- Duration **15 s**, ratio **9:16**, resolution 720p (1080p if your UI offers it)
- Upload nothing; it's a text-only prompt
- Add VO, music and logo in the edit

```text
Text-only generation, no reference files.

A 15-second vertical promo in three shots joined by hard cuts, quiet storybook realism: a 7-year-old girl's unanswered question on a night window turns into a book that answers it, then children from toddler to teenager reading side by side in warm lamplight. 35mm lens look, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, deep graphite shadows, one red accent.

Girl (identical in every shot): 7-year-old Armenian girl, dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair, brown eyes, light olive skin, white long-sleeved cotton pajamas.
Book (identical in every shot): thick hardcover picture book with a plain matte black cover, cream pages and a single red satin ribbon bookmark.

[0-4.5s] Shot 1, close-up, night. The girl kneels on a window seat in a dark graphite bedroom, cool blue moonlight from frame-left through the glass. She breathes on the cold window, the glass fogs, and with her index fingertip she draws one large question mark in the fog, finishing with the dot. She lowers her hand and looks up past the question mark at the dark sky, brows slightly raised, lips closed, waiting. Camera: very slow push-in from her shoulder to the question mark. Ends on the finished question mark sharp in the fog, her eye soft and blurred behind it. Sound: quiet room tone, her soft breath on the glass, a faint squeak of fingertip on glass.

[4.5-9.5s] Shot 2, hard cut, medium shot to close-up. The same girl in the same white pajamas sits cross-legged on her bed; at the cut a small lamp at frame-right switches on, warm amber light. The black book with the red ribbon lies open on her lap; she turns one page from right to left. Light reflected from the cream page lights her face from below; her eyes widen, her lips part slightly, then a small smile starts at one corner of her mouth. The pages show only soft watercolor illustrations, no legible letters. Camera: slow push-in from medium shot to close-up of her face. Ends on her close-up, smiling, eyes on the page. Sound: lamp switch click exactly at the cut, one paper page turn, soft room tone.

[9.5-15s] Shot 3, hard cut, wide shot. A long low wooden window bench in a dark graphite room lit by three small warm lamps. Three children sit side by side, each absorbed in a book: at frame-right a 2-year-old toddler turning a thick board book with both hands; in the middle the same 7-year-old girl in white pajamas with the black book and red ribbon; at frame-left a 15-year-old teenage boy in a plain grey hoodie reading a thick novel. Camera: slow lateral dolly from right to left along the row from 9.5 to 13s, then a slow tilt up from 13 to 15s, leaving the children soft and low at the bottom edge and the top two-thirds of the frame on an empty dark graphite wall. Ends on that empty wall with warm lamp glow along the bottom edge, held still for the final second. Sound: two quiet page turns, soft room tone.

Global: the girl, her white pajamas and the black book with the red ribbon stay identical across all three shots. Palette: black, graphite, white and warm amber lamplight; the red ribbon is the only red in the film. Nobody speaks, no lip movement, no narration. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no background music. No legible writing on pages, covers or walls. No adults, no extra children, no toys, no cartoon characters. The question mark is the only drawing on the window, and the final wall stays empty.
```

**Timeline**
- **0–4.5 s:** The girl draws a question mark on the fogged window under cold moonlight. VO: "Every child has a question…"
- **4.5 s:** Lamp click and hard cut.
- **4.5–9.5 s:** She opens the book in warm light and her face lights up. VO: "We write the books…"
- **9.5 s:** Hard cut.
- **9.5–13 s:** The camera dollies along the toddler, the girl and the teenager. VO: "Maghakian Scripts. Books for ages 0–16."
- **13–15 s:** The camera tilts up to the empty wall. In the edit, fade in the white logo and «Գրքեր 0-ից 16 տարեկանների համար» from about 12.8 s.
